{"consolidated_memory":"## ml/serving/batcher.py: Five Latency Spike Fixes in the Batcher

All five occasions addressed latency spikes in ml/serving/batcher.py (ml pipeline side). Each showed the same signal—a tail far above the median in the serving histogram—but with different triggers, root causes, fixes, and outcomes. Repro for all: send the mixed-size request trace.

### Occasion 1: [2026-01-20] - Floating Point Rounding
- **Trigger:** Only for tenants with more than ten thousand distinct keys
- **Root cause:** Floating point rounding in the money path
- **Fix:** Moved the arithmetic to integer minor units
- **PR:** #2051, branch: fix/latency-spike-1
- **Outcome:** Job finished in 31 minutes instead of 2 hours

### Occasion 2: [2026-03-01] - Naive vs. Aware Datetime
- **Trigger:** Only for payloads above roughly two megabytes
- **Root cause:** Naive datetime compared against an aware one
- **Fix:** Made every boundary timezone aware at the edge
- **PR:** #4842, branch: fix/latency-spike-2
- **Test coverage:** tests/ml/test_batcher.py
- **Stack:** Python
- **Outcome:** Reclaimed 79 GB of blob storage

### Occasion 3: [2026-05-27] - Cache Entry Never Invalidated on Write
- **Trigger:** Only after a rolling restart of the fleet
- **Root cause:** Cache entry that was never invalidated on write
- **Fix:** Invalidated the entry inside the write transaction
- **PR:** #5627, branch: fix/latency-spike-3
- **Outcome:** Cold start dropped 20 percent, to 724 ms

### Occasion 4: [2026-06-24] - Mutable Default Argument
- **Trigger:** Only for jobs scheduled across the midnight boundary
- **Root cause:** Mutable default argument shared across calls
- **Fix:** Made the default empty and built the value per call
- **PR:** #8553, branch: fix/latency-spike-5
- **Outcome:** 45 duplicate rows a day stopped being written

### Occasion 5: [2026-07-22] - Missing Composite Index
- **Trigger:** Only for clients still pinned to the v1 SDK
- **Root cause:** Missing composite index on (tenant_id, created_at)
- **Fix:** Added the composite index and backfilled in batches
- **PR:** #8666, branch: fix/latency-spike-6
- **Outcome:** Flaky test went from 74 failures per hundred runs to zero

All work was conducted in the same corner of ml/serving/batcher.py, with context carried over across the occasions."}
